title: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Flow Malfunction
shortDescription: Measured EGR flow does not match commanded flow.
fullDescription: P0400 relates to the exhaust gas recirculation subsystem, which routes a measured amount of exhaust gas back into the intake to lower combustion temperatures and NOx output. Carbon buildup, sticking valves, vacuum leaks, and electrical faults are the dominant failure modes.
safetyImpact: EGR faults raise NOx emissions and can cause detonation under load.

causes.cause: Damaged vacuum line or actuator (older systems)

symptoms: Rough idle when EGR is stuck open

fixSteps.title: Inspect EGR Valve
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the EGR valve and inspect the pintle and seat for carbon deposits.

fixSteps.title: Clean Passages
fixSteps.instruction: Use intake cleaner and a small wire to clear EGR passages in the intake manifold.

fixSteps.title: Test Solenoid and Sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Measure resistance of the EGR solenoid and verify position-sensor sweep.

fixSteps.title: Replace EGR Valve
fixSteps.instruction: If cleaning fails, install a new EGR valve and clear codes.

faq.q: Will premium fuel help?
faq.a: It does not address EGR carbon. Top-tier fuel can slow but not reverse buildup.

faq.q: How long can I drive with P0401?
faq.a: Short trips are usually fine, but pinging under load risks detonation damage.

title: Secondary Air Injection System Incorrect Flow Detected
shortDescription: Secondary air flow does not match command.
fullDescription: P0411 reports a fault in the cold-start secondary air injection system, which uses an electric pump to push fresh air into the exhaust during the first 60-90 seconds after a cold start. Failures usually involve seized check valves, water-damaged pumps, or corroded relays.
safetyImpact: Affects emissions during cold start; no driveability impact when engine is warm.

causes.cause: Water intrusion in pump or hose

symptoms: Loud whirring on cold start that fails to stop

fixSteps.title: Verify Pump Operation
fixSteps.instruction: Use a scan tool to command the pump on and listen for proper run-down.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Check Valves
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and inspect check valves between pump and exhaust manifold for corrosion.

fixSteps.title: Test Relay and Fuse
fixSteps.instruction: Verify relay clicks and fuse is intact when commanded on.

fixSteps.title: Replace Failed Component
fixSteps.instruction: Install new pump, valves, or relay as required.

faq.q: Is this safe to ignore?
faq.a: Driveability is unaffected, but you will fail emissions tests.

faq.q: Why does it whir for so long?
faq.a: A stuck-on relay or PCM driver can keep the pump running, which damages it.

title: Exhaust Gas Recirculation B Control Circuit High
shortDescription: EGR B control circuit voltage above threshold.
fullDescription: P0490 indicates a fault in a secondary EGR or related emissions actuator. The PCM monitors the actuator's electrical state and feedback. Wiring damage, seized actuators, and carbon plugging are the most frequent root causes.
safetyImpact: Reduced emissions performance; may cause limp mode if actuator is stuck.

fixSteps.title: Pull Freeze Frame Data
fixSteps.instruction: Capture freeze frame to identify operating conditions when the fault occurred.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Actuator and Wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect actuator and inspect for corrosion or carbon.

fixSteps.title: Functional Test
fixSteps.instruction: Use bidirectional scan tool to actuate and watch live data.

fixSteps.title: Replace Failed Component
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the failed actuator and clear codes.

faq.q: Can I drive with this code?
faq.a: Yes for short trips, but address it before your next emissions test.

faq.q: Will the code clear itself?
faq.a: Only if the underlying fault was intermittent and fully resolved.

safetyImpact: Reduced emissions performance; may cause limp mode if actuator is stuck.

fixSteps.title: Pull Freeze Frame Data
fixSteps.instruction: Capture freeze frame to identify operating conditions when the fault occurred.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Actuator and Wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect actuator and inspect for corrosion or carbon.

fixSteps.title: Functional Test
fixSteps.instruction: Use bidirectional scan tool to actuate and watch live data.

fixSteps.title: Replace Failed Component
fixSteps.instruction: Replace the failed actuator and clear codes.

faq.q: Can I drive with this code?
faq.a: Yes for short trips, but address it before your next emissions test.

faq.q: Will the code clear itself?
faq.a: Only if the underlying fault was intermittent and fully resolved.
